fieldValues.title: One fractal compass: the SRS compass is its most developed node, and its mechanism runs at every level
fieldValues.move: Treat the SRS decision compass as the most developed part of one fractal compass, not a separate thing, and keep its lenses apart (owner, vignette cad03157). Its 3x4 grid crosses elements with levels (Individual, Relational, Systemic). Its modality diagonals (Cardinal, Fixed, Mutable) are what correspond to the fractal's three lines, so a domain places each pair of opposite cells on the line of their shared modality. Its levels are a separate lens and are not read as lines. Carry its mechanism to every level: a decision proposed in any domain names the domain and the axes or principles it was weighed on (set-against), and passes a level test that relocates it to the level that owns it, retires it, or holds it with a named payer. clerk pr-check and the session apply that check, as the rfc skill's Charter Check does for the spec. Grow the content from evidence: a domain gets its own affirmed axes and leans when decision-stop findings and boundary tags show decisions landing there, starting with the domains that collect the most.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not write the compasses for the 13 domains without affirmed axes; it makes clear which ones are needed first. It does not change the SRS compass.
fieldValues.falsifier: After a month, decisions in programme domains still reach the owner without a domain or cited axis, or the check passes decisions that the level test should have relocated.
